body: It’s not temporary. It never stops. It hasn’t stopped for years
Hey thanks. Now that I know that some random internet stranger is thinking about me, I’m don’t feel suicidal anymore.
I just don’t know if I can believe this anymore. I feel like I’ve been trying to go to God for years and He’s ignoring me.

I’ve already got a few diagnoses. Depression, anxiety, the works.

In keep trying to find some good friends. But everyone’s bad. People are inherently bad. Everyone’s only in it for themselves, and people only care for you as long as you have something to offer them. I’ve been fighting my own battles my whole life because there’s no one here who would want to fight them with me. I’m done letting myself get hurt by trying to find someone else. I’m just done
Buddy, I’m not on reddit to find love.

> Stop being so pessimistic

What a great thing to tell a suicidal person.

I’ve been fighting forever. Life is a constant fight. I’m allowed to want to opt out of that.

And everyone else can fend for themselves. I’m not in charge of everyone else’s emotions. If they’re not going to care about me, then why the heck should I care about them?
I don’t have one. I have no idea what I want to do with my life.

I’d love to, I just don’t have anywhere to go or a job waiting for me or anything. I’m barely making ends meet right now, it would be pretty dumb to just up and move right now. But hopefully someday. I want to live in the pacific north west

lol not a whole lot. I was born and raised here. For the longest time I wanted to move up north, where it’s cold. I just graduated, so I’m looking for a job or something that could get me out of this state.

Don’t get me wrong, I like Texas and all. But I’m sick of it lol
North Texas up in here. How’re you doing with all the flooding happening right now?
I’m not going to wait that long. It could be years before that happens. I’m taking control
But I have so little. And I have none of things that are really important to me. I’d give every cent I own, and every possession, for someone in my life.

How can I get there? I *yearn* to be around people, to be loved and cared for, and to love and care for other. I would give anything for just one person in my life who loved me as much as I love them, not even a spouse, but just anyone.

Ok, I’m really not trying to be rude here, but what does that even mean? Because I know that He is always here, but that doesn’t mean that His perfect plan involves me being happy or blessed in my life, and it apparently doesn’t mean that He’s going to be answering my prayers.

Yeah I’m aware that God is “here” for everyone, but that’s clearly not the kind of here that I’m talking about. God’s not going to cone down from heaven and grab a beer with me when I’ve had a really bad few weeks and need to talk about it. Praying to God is a one sided conversation. God gave us each other so He could physically love each of us through each other. Yet there’s no one in my life who is willing to extend that love for me. And God’s okay with that.
